a letter

everything i never know how to say out loud

🤍   just for you hoshiro

dear reju,

i don't really know how to start this. i've rewritten this in my head like a hundred times and every version sounds either too much or not enough, so i'm just going to say it all and hope it lands the way i mean it. i was so scared when i first messaged you. genuinely terrified. i didn't know what i was doing or what i wanted, i just knew i wanted to talk to you. this was back when I first joined MR and look at where we are now. when I got out of a relationship with gabe, you were honestly the first person I thought of, wondering what youd be thinking. a couple days later, you just opened up to me out of the blue which is the most you thing that has ever happened until then and somehow that was the moment i realized i was in serious trouble. the good kind. god, you have no clue how outstandingly excited I was that day, id kill to relive it. im honestly sometimes jealous at the gifts I get you because they can be in your house and see you all day while I cant. its honestly unfair as hell ngl. anyway, jokes aside, they are there so you can understand my unrelenting love for you even without my presence. im risking getting in trouble for my baby and its totally worth it. youre worth a thousand worlds to me. you make me feel safe in a way i don't fully have words for. like the world can be falling apart and then you're there and it just... quiets down. the nights where we talked about nothing and everything, those are some of my favorite moments i've ever had. with anyone. ever. my life is genuinely better with you in it. in a way i notice every single day. you make things brighter without even trying, and i don't think you fully understand what that does to a person. i love you. unrelentingly. chaotically. completely. i'm not going anywhere.

with everything i have, mete
